about: Legal review deadlines for ADU applications, from the HCD ADU Handbook (March 2026) and the statute text as read on mirror sites (D5). Confirmation on leginfo is still pending.

clocks.label: Completeness check, in writing
clocks.note: Handbook p. 34. With no timely determination, the application is deemed complete (66317(a)(2)(F), p. 35).

clocks.label: Approve or deny after a complete application
clocks.note: Handbook p. 11. Tolled only for a delay the applicant requests (p. 35).

clocks.label: "Deemed approved" if the city misses the 60 days
clocks.note: The statute text, read on two mirror sites but not yet on leginfo, says: "If the local agency has not approved or denied the completed application within 60 days, the application shall be deemed approved." Handbook p. 51 agrees; p. 21 is about coastal permits (66329(b)(5)). Unconfirmed until read on leginfo.
